newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT SOFTER IN LATE TRADING.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT SOFTER IN LATE TRADING.

text.p: September Brent futures weakened in late trading on Thursday, pulled down by a lack of activity on the market.
September Brent on SIMEX last traded at $19.14 per barrel, after London lost 35 cents to close at $19.20.
But only 68 lots were traded, well below the normal average of around 100 lots, brokers said.

They said news of an Iraqi resumption of crude exports within a fortnight was also still having an impact on prices. They said that the surge in prices early this week was due to some late buying, but the rise was temporary and pices have been moving downwards most of the week.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded at $20.43 per barrel, down three cents from New York's $20.46.
